The floor is 0.15 base-widths thick; shaft windows penetrate the walls. Width/depth is 1.86; height/horizontal-span is 1.54. Upper stages narrow above the base. Crown-height above shaft-bottom is 1.10 shaft-heights. Across 2 opaque colors, the shaft is mainly brown and the crown is tan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
